coordinateRules.scroll: Section rects are in unscrolled content space, clipped by scroll viewport.
coordinateRules.defaultSnapshot: Properties selected, no search, picker closed, approved disclosure state.
coordinateRules.reflow: Sections follow tab flow order with 8 px gap. Expanding/collapsing changes height and reflows subsequent sections. Search reveals matching controls and reflows visible rows.
coordinateRules.resize: At scale1: panel318px centered at (clientWidth-318)/2, top12, height max(240,clientHeight-24). ApplyTheme(scale) scales style and explicit geometry; DrawInspector accepts physical client dimensions and converts to logical units. All contract rects are logical 1x px; ControlRect reports physical px.
coordinateRules.filter: Native search matches section title/keyword list, forces matching sections open, and displays all controls inside each matching section. No Document values are cleared.

scalar.synchronization: Number and slider bind the same Document field and clamp to ScalarSpecs().

color.storedColorSpace: Display sRGB values normalized to 0..1; host engine applies its own linear conversion.

components.label: Material color symbol
components.rendering: Decorative swatch/gradient symbol only; no rendered material preview.

components.label: Attribute sections
components.filter: Match section title and keyword list case-insensitively; show every control of matching sections.

placement.clampTo: 8px horizontal inset; popup height min(578, clientHeight-24); y clamped to clientHeight-popupHeight-8
placement.fallback: overlay inspector if client width cannot fit alongside

components.label: Saturation and brightness
components.displayTransform: pickerHSV[1..2] x 100; stored saturation/value are normalized 0..1

components.label: Hue
components.displayTransform: pickerHSV[0] x 360; stored hue is normalized 0..1

styleInheritance: All components inherit theme.typography family/weight and default size. Component typography references override the corresponding theme style.
